tools.name: keyword_metrics
tools.description: Google search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty (0-100), search intent and the last 12 months of volume for up to 100 keywords in one country. Keywords without data are listed in noData and not charged. Billed per started block of 10 keywords that have data.

tools.name: google_serp
tools.description: Live Google organic results for one keyword: position, title, URL, domain and snippet, plus which SERP features appear (AI Overview, People Also Ask, local pack, video...) and the AI Overview text. Optionally give target_domain to get that domain's best position (rank check). Billed per 10 results o

tools.name: rank_check
tools.description: Where one domain ranks on live Google for up to 10 keywords in one country: best position, ranking URL and the top 3 domains for each keyword, plus SERP features. Same data and price as google_serp, billed per 10 results of depth for each keyword that returns results.

tools.name: domain_overview
tools.description: For up to 100 domains: estimated monthly organic traffic and number of ranking keywords in one country (Google), paid keywords, plus backlink profile: domain rank (0-1000), backlinks, referring domains, spam score, first seen. Billed per started block of 10 domains that have data.

tools.name: ranked_keywords
tools.description: The Google keywords a domain (or URL) ranks for in one country, sorted by estimated traffic: keyword, position, ranking URL, search volume, CPC and estimated visits. Up to 100 keywords per call, plus position distribution totals. Billed per call with data.

tools.name: backlinks
tools.description: Backlinks or referring domains pointing to a domain or page URL, strongest first: linking page/domain, anchor, dofollow, first/last seen and rank. Up to 100 rows per call, plus the target's totals. Billed per call with data.

tools.name: google_trends
tools.description: Google Trends interest over time (0-100) for up to 5 keywords compared, in a country or worldwide, for web, YouTube, news, images or shopping search, plus each keyword's average. Billed per call with data.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: YouTube search results for a query in ranked order: video ID, title, channel, views, publish date, duration and whether it is a Short. Up to 40 results. Billed per 20 results of depth.

tools.name: youtube_video
tools.description: Public stats for one YouTube video (views, likes, comment count, channel subscribers, tags, category, description, duration, publish date) and optionally its transcript. Billed per video; the transcript is billed separately and only if the video has captions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: google_serp, rank_check, ranked_keywords · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: google_serp, rank_check, ranked_keywords · Public sink: youtube_search, youtube_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
